summary: Israel is commanded: Be holy, live righteously, love your neighbor, and keep the commandments—The Lord reveals and reaffirms sundry laws and commandments—Enchantments, wizardry, prostitution, and all evil practices are forbidden.
meta_description: Israel is commanded: Be holy, live righteously, love your neighbor, and keep the commandments—The Lord reveals and reaffirms sundry laws and commandments—Enchantments, wizardry, prostitution, and all evil practices are forbidden.

footnotes.note2_a: OR saints or holy ones. Josh. 24:19; Isa. 5:16; D&C 82:14. TG God, the Standard of Righteousness; Holiness.
footnotes.note14_e: HEB Jehovah. Note that this phrase occurs fifteen times like a seal of authority upon each of these statutes.
footnotes.note15_c: IE show unjust favoritism either to the humble or the mighty. Deut. 1:17; D&C 38:25 (25–27).
footnotes.note17_a: IE Though you may reprove a neighbor and not tolerate his sin, do not hate him. Jacob 2:7; D&C 121:43.
footnotes.note19_a: Note that these laws are in harmony with the other admonitions to keep things pure and in proper use. TG Separation.
footnotes.note20_b: HEB there shall be an investigation or inquisition.
footnotes.note26_b: HEB you shall not divine or use sorcery.
footnotes.note27_a: IE by cutting the forelocks of the hair of the head. Lev. 21:5.
footnotes.note31_a: HEB Do not turn to magic or necromancy.
footnotes.note32_a: HEB rise before the face of old age.
footnotes.note32_c: TG Courtesy; Family, Children, Duties of; Respect.
footnotes.note34_b: HEB as a citizen of yours.
